tiers.static: one binary, zero non-system imports (ELF: DT_NEEDED empty; PE: only kernel32/msvcrt; Mach-O: dyld cache only)
tiers.macho: one Mach-O importing only OS-shipped dylibs
tiers.sfx: static carrier + zstd blob region carrying a tree (compiler resources, stdlib, JRE)
tiers.layer: sfx whose shared runtime trees are content-addressed, so two bundles carrying the same JRE/stdlib store it once on disk
tiers.none: not buildable for this target; see notes

status_legend.ga: built, verified and exercised by CI on this target
status_legend.experimental: recipe exists and compiles, but the target is not covered by the green matrix
status_legend.planned: declared with a known approach, recipe branch not written yet
status_legend.not-supported: physically or upstream impossible; the reason is in notes
